title: Trump-Backed Moore Captures Alabama GOP Senate Nomination
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Moore Wins Alabama Senate Runoff, Secures Republican Nomination.webp
excerpt: Trump-backed Moore won Alabama’s Republican Senate runoff election, securing the party’s nomination in a race that will help shape the battle for control of the U.S. Senate.

title: House Approves $70 Billion Immigration Enforcement Bill After Months of Republican Delays
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: The U.S. House narrowly approved a $70 billion immigration enforcement bill funding ICE and Border Patrol through 2029, delivering a major victory for President Donald Trump's immigration agenda.

title: Barack Obama Opens Presidential Center on Chicago’s South Side
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Former President Barack Obama officially opened the Obama Presidential Center in Chicago, unveiling a landmark campus dedicated to civic engagement, community development and preserving his presidential legacy.

title: Zohran Mamdani Sparks Controversy with Warning to Wealthy New Yorkers Over Pied à Terre Tax
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/NYC Mayor Mamdani Faces Backlash Over Comments on Wealthy Homeowners and ‘Fair Share’ Taxes.webp
excerpt: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s remarks urging wealthy homeowners to pay a “fair share” in taxes — including on pied à terre properties — have drawn strong criticism and an online backlash from political opponents.

title: UK Lawmakers Debate Donation Limits as Concerns Grow Over Big Money in Politics
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/UK Faces Fresh Push to Limit Mega-Donations in Politics.webp
excerpt: British lawmakers are facing renewed pressure to tighten political donation rules after record-breaking contributions from wealthy individuals sparked concerns over transparency and influence in UK politics.

title: Graham Platner Drops Out of Maine Senate Race After Controversy as Democrats Begin Replacement Process
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Graham Platner Ends Maine Senate Campaign, Leaving Democrats Searching for Replacement.webp
excerpt: Graham Platner has ended his Maine Senate campaign after allegations and controversy disrupted his bid, leaving Democrats racing to select a replacement candidate before the election deadline.

title: US Supreme Court Rules Against Trump on Birthright Citizenship, Reaffirms Constitutional Protections
author: Emily Rodriguez
image: /images/news/Supreme Court Rejects Trump Bid to End Birthright Citizenship, Upholds 14th Amendment.webp
excerpt: The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected President Donald Trump’s executive order restricting birthright citizenship, reaffirming the 14th Amendment and long-standing precedent granting citizenship to those born on U.S. soil.

title: South Carolina Republicans Block Effort to Redraw James Clyburn District
author: David Smith
excerpt: South Carolina Republicans blocked a Trump-backed redistricting proposal targeting Congressman James Clyburn’s district, exposing divisions inside the GOP ahead of the 2026 midterms.
